title: Reading Drill — Storing Winter Sports Equipment
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Storing Winter Sports Equipment
passages.body:
**A** A school stored skis on their sides in a narrow room. Students often hit the wall when taking out longer pairs, so a teacher marked the handling space required for the longest skis.

**B** The first trial mounted the skis vertically, leaving more floor space. However, younger students could not reach the upper clips without a stool.

**C** A revised rack supported the skis from below and moved the clips to waist height. The room still needed a clear walkway so a pair could be carried to the door.

questions.prompt: Students often hit the wall when taking out longer pairs, so a teacher marked the ______ required for the longest skis.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Students often hit the wall when taking out longer pairs, so a teacher marked the handling space required for the longest skis.

questions.prompt: However, younger students could not reach the ______ without a stool.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: However, younger students could not reach the upper clips without a stool.

questions.prompt: The room still needed a clear ______ so a pair could be carried to the door.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: The room still needed a clear walkway so a pair could be carried to the door.

questions.prompt: The storage room was kept at a constant temperature.
questions.instructions: Does this statement agree with the information in the passage?
questions.explanation: The passage does not state this information.

questions.prompt: Which paragraph mentions the limitation of the first vertical arrangement?
questions.explanation: The first trial mounted the skis vertically, leaving more floor space. However, younger students could not reach the upper clips without a stool.
